verdict.rationale: Grok Business documents email invitations for workspace members, SSO integration with an identity provider, and license-gated conversation sharing, so the member-management part of the story is covered. Permissions and data policies are thinly supported: the docs only mention generic 'enterprise-grade privacy protections' and business plan terms, not settings an admin can configure. Missing for 10: role/permission management controls, admin-configurable data retention or usage policies, member removal or deprovisioning docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace

citations.quote: Invite new team members to join your Grok Business workspace with a simple email invitation process.
Secure and streamline logins by integrating Single Sign-On (SSO) with your preferred Identity Provider (IdP).
Share conversations only with team members who have active licenses.
In your team workspace, enjoy enterprise-grade privacy protections
